t: Din birkot asher yatzar veelohay neshama uperushayv
s: Din birkot asher yatzar veelohay neshama uperushayv ubo t' seipim: ap-al-pi shemmiddina digmara en tzarik lebarek birkat "asher yatzar" ella kesheasa tzerakayv, mikkol maqom nahagu haolam lebarek bekol shacharit tekep achar birkat "al netilat yadayim" birkat "asher yatzar", lepi shebbekol yom naaseh haadam beriyya chadasha, laken shayyak lebarek bekol yom vayom "asher yatzar et haadam bechokma". Veharotzeh lehistalleq mehassapeq — yizzaher laasot tzerakayv tekep umiyyad achar netilat yadayim shacharit, ukesheyyetze mibbet hakkisse yittol yadayv paam shenit vibarek "asher yatzar", veyetze yede chobato bebirkat "asher yatzar" zo, ap im haya mechuyyab lebarek "asher yatzar" al mah shennaasa beriyya chadasha, ki beraka achat ola lekan ulekan. Vetob shello yebarek birkat "al netilat yadayim" ad leachar netila shenit, shennotel achar yetziato mibbet hakkisse. Ubiprat im tzarik linqabayv, sheaz asur lo lebarek:

Yesh nohagim keshemmashkimin babboqer verotzim lelek tekep umiyyad lebet hakkeneset lehitpallel — mamtinim lebarek "al netilat yadayim" ad boam lebet hakkeneset, umesadderin birkot "al netilat yadayim" im shear birkot hashshachar, mippene sheiqqar taqqanat netilat yadayim bashshachar hu kede lehitqaddesh uletaher yadenu qodem abodatenu, kemo kohen shehaya meqaddesh yadayv qodem abodato, vekevan sheiqqar haaboda hu lehallelo uleshabbecho ulehitpallel lepanayv, laken qodem hattepilla shayyak lebarek "al netilat yadayim", sheim en tepilla — en netilat yadayim:

Bammeh debarim amurim, kesheholekin lebet hakkeneset tekep achar netilat yadayim, umatchilin miyyad lesadder seder habberakot. Abal asur lehapsiq ben netila labberaka belimmud o beshum tepilla, vekol shekken bidbarim acherim. Umi sherotzeh lehapsiq benetayim, kegon ellu sheomerim tehillim qodem hattepilla, veken bime selichot sheomerim selichot qodem hatchalat hattepilla — yizzaher lebarek "al netilat yadayim" bebeto tekep achar hannetila:

Lepikak mah shennohagim bime hasselichot ubeyamim noraim, shelleachar shemmapsiqin baamirat hasselichot o baamirat tehillim ushear debarim — matchilin lebarek "al netilat yadayim" va"asher yatzar" — mimmah napshaka lo yapeh hem osim vetzarik limchot beyadam: im lo bereku adayin "al netilat yadayim" va"asher yatzar" — im ken heve hepseq merubbeh velo nakon laasot ken kemo shennitbaer, veim kebar bereku — im ken hem osim akshav beraka lebattala. Vaapillu hashsheliach tzibbur — lo yebarek shette peamim. Vaapillu im hu mekavven bappaam hashsheniyya kede lehotzi et harabbim yede chobatan — apillu hake have beraka lebattala, shehare bazzeman hazzeh kullam beqiim veyodeim lebarek vekol echad mebarek leatzmo. Usheliach tzibbur sheeno rotzeh leshannot hamminhag shello lebarek "al netilat yadayim" va"asher yatzar" lipne hatteba — yizzaher shello lebarek ellu habberakot qodem yeridato lipne hatteba, vegam yizzaher shello lehapsiq ben netilat yadayim lebirkat "al netilat yadayim" baamirat tehillim velo belimmud, vekol shekken bidbarim acherim:

Abal yesh nohagin lebarek "al netilat yadayim" va"asher yatzar" bebetam miyyad achar hannetila, ukeshebbaim lebet hakkeneset mebarekim kol birkot hashshachar, lebad meotan berakot shebbereku bebetam sheen mebarekim otam paam sheniyya. Uminhag zeh yapeh hu, verauy linhog ken, shehare kol hammitzvot tzarik lebarek alehen qodem laasiyyatan, ella shebbintilat yadayim i epshar lebarek qodem hannetila, laken nidchet habberaka ad leachar hannetila, im ken kol mah deepshar leqareb habberaka shettehe semuka lehannetila — tzarik leqareb, velo lehapsiq benetayim:

Kol habberakot potechin be"baruk", chutz mibberaka hassemuka lachabertah, kegon "ahaba rabba" shehi semuka le"yotzer or" veday lah be"baruk" shebbiptichat "yotzer or"; vechutz mibbirkat hahodaa, kegon "modim anachnu lak al kol tippa vetippa ku'" shemmebarekim al haggeshamim, sheen tzarik liptoach bah be"baruk", kevan shehi kullah leshon hodaa. Veken kol kayyotze baellu:

Birkat "elohay neshama" enah semuka lebirkat "asher yatzar", shehare miyyad shenneor mishshenato tzarik lebarek "elohay neshama" middina digmara, va"asher yatzar" en tzarik lebarek ad sheyyaaseh tzerakayv. Umah sheenah potachat bebaruk, haynu lepi shehi birkat hahodaa. Umikkol maqom tob lesomkah lebirkat "asher yatzar", kede shettehe beraka hassemuka lachabertah, shedday lah be"baruk" shebbitchillat beraka rishona:

Hammashkim laqum veyodea sheyyitztarek od lishon paam sheniyya shenat qeba — yomar "elohay neshama" beli chatima, ukesheyyirtzeh lishon paam sheniyya — yomar birkat "hammappil" beli peticha, raq yomar "baruk hammappil cheble ku'" ad hachatima velo ad biklal, ukesheyyaqum bepaam sheniyya — yomar "elohay neshama ku'" im chatimatah. Abal birkat "al netilat yadayim" — lo yebarek, raq kesheqqam mimmittato bepaam rishona, kemo shennitbaer besiman d:

Yesh nohagin sheachar shebberak echad birkot hashshachar veanu acharayv amen — chozer echad mehaonim amen umebarek gam ken kol birkot hashshachar veonin acharayv amen, vekasseder hazzeh osin kol otan sheanu amen techilla, veosin ken kede laanot tz' amenim bekol yom. Veen learer alehem velomar shekkebar yatzeu yede chobatan beamen sheanu techilla, mippene shehambarek eno mekavven lehotzi acherim yede chobatan, vaapillu im haya hambarek mekavven lehotzi acherim yede chobatan — hem enam mekavvenim latzet bebirkato:
